ingress.rfc6455_handshake: Verified 101 Switching Protocols with Sec-WebSocket-Accept digest sha1(key + GUID); version mismatch returns 400 with Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
ingress.nonconflicting: Normal HTTP requests (e.g. /healthz) served without interference; other upgrade paths co-hosted or drained cleanly

framing_and_bounds.rfc6455_compliance: Fin/opcode/mask/7-16-64 bit lengths; client masking enforced (unmasked client frames fail 1002); ping/pong frames handled
framing_and_bounds.max_envelope_bytes: Frames exceeding 8192 bytes (or accumulated fragments exceeding 8192 bytes) close with 1009 (Message Too Big) without memory leaks

ticket_redemption.atomic_redemption: One-use ticket redeemed in PostgreSQL via redeemRealtimeTicket(core_runtime pool)
ticket_redemption.rejections: Replayed tickets fail TICKET_REDEEMED and close 1008; expired tickets fail TICKET_EXPIRED and close 1008; invalid tickets fail TICKET_INVALID and close 1008

subscription_membership.membership_check: Subscription requests verify authenticated actor is in match.participants for match_id in PostgreSQL
subscription_membership.rejections: Pre-auth subscription fails AUTH_REQUIRED; scope mismatch fails FORBIDDEN; non-participant fails NOT_PARTICIPANT; missing match fails UNKNOWN_MATCH
subscription_membership.safe_errors: All error frames carry bare PUBLIC_CODES from packages/contracts/realtime.js

leak_free_lifecycle.teardown: Socket destroy/end immediately clears connection tracking; close() sends 1000 to all sockets and drains registry; Redis route keys released; zero lingering timers
